title: 第17章 巨型青花玉第18章 彻底服气了
content_zh:
“你说什么！”
赵锐凌打开房门，直勾勾盯着曾平。
曾平连忙道：“赵师兄，我说，韩林出门了！”
“当真？”
“千真万确，我亲眼所见的！”
“好，好好好，天堂有路你不走，地狱无门你闯进来！”赵锐凌脸上浮起一抹狞笑。
“马上去喊弟兄们，到矿洞入口集合！”说罢，锁上房门，急匆匆朝营地外面走去。
没过多久，矿洞入口处就集结了一大帮人。
其中就包括曾平和岳青山。
这一年多时间，岳青山的收获虽然远不如韩林，但胜在刻苦，加上天赋也还行，此时竟同样突破了练气一层。
前几天，听说韩林竟然一夜赚了上万积分，岳青山嫉妒的眼睛都红了，做梦都在想，自己怎么就没那么好运。
如今听说韩林竟然不躲着修炼，反而往矿洞跑，心里顿时平衡了不少。
暗道这丑八怪空有一身运气，脑袋却不好使。这下好了，刚到手还没焐热的积分，马上就要成为赵师兄的囊中之物。
到时赵师兄一高兴，没准儿还会赏我们一些积分。
想到此处，岳青山就忍不住笑了起来。
“笑你妹啊！赶紧跟上去，矿洞那么大，一会儿可不好找。”赵锐凌狠狠瞪了岳青山一眼。
“呃，是，是！”
岳青山回过神，连忙跟着众人往洞道里面跑。
另一边。
韩林早已深入矿洞，来到中段一片错综复杂的区域，好像迷宫一样，到处都是被开采过的矿道。

韩林没有自己开辟新的通道，而是在别人开采过的地方，利用通天之眼捡漏。
不过今天的运气好像不行，连续逛了好几条通道，两侧的石壁里面，都没有夹杂青花玉。
正准备从一条弯曲的通道出来，却忽然听到外面传来一阵脚步声，似乎有人正往这里面走。
韩林一下警惕起来，躲在拐角处向外看。
“岳青山？”
这一看，他便看到了一个胖子，正东张西望地朝里面走来。
这岳青山可能是吃的多了，这一年下来，身体竟然放大了一圈，满脸都是肥肉。
在这狭窄的通道里面，行走起来十分困难。
“韩林，你在里面吗韩林！”来到一个特别狭隘的地方，岳青山不想往里面挤了，就停下来大喊。
韩林已然猜到，这岳青山恐怕是奉了赵锐凌的命令，特意来寻找自己的，便装作没听见。
岳青山喊了几声，见里面一点反应也没有，暗暗咒骂了一句，转身就走了。
来到外面，遇到同样在搜寻韩林的曾平几人。
曾平，朝岳青山身后的通道看了一眼，问：“没有？”
岳青山摇摇头：“没有，那王八蛋，也不知道藏哪里去了，一会儿找到了定要让他好看！”
此话一出，顿时让躲在内部的韩林，心头一冷。
曾平道：“那算了，大家继续往前搜吧，切不可放过任何一条通道！赵师兄说了，谁先找到韩林，奖励一百积分！”
“是！”
听到此话，众人纷纷精神一振，快步向前走去。
韩林躲在通道里面，直到曾平一行人彻底走远，才谨慎地从里面出来，继续寻找青花玉。
曾平等人根本也没想到，韩林会在他们已经搜寻过的区域，找了一个多时辰，也没找到韩林踪迹。

眼见时间不早了，便回到主干道上，找赵锐凌说明情况。
content_en:
"What did you say!"
Zhao Ruiling opened the door and stared at Zeng Ping.
Zeng Ping said quickly: "Senior Brother Zhao, let me tell you, Han Lin is out!"
"Seriously?"
"It's absolutely true, I saw it with my own eyes!"
"Okay, okay, okay, if you don't take the road to heaven, there is no door to hell and you break in!" A sinister smile appeared on Zhao Ruiling's face.
"Go call the brothers immediately and gather at the entrance of the mine!" After that, he locked the door and hurried out of the camp.
Before long, a large group of people gathered at the entrance of the mine.
Among them were Zeng Ping and Yue Qingshan.
Over the past year or so, although Yue Qingshan's gains were far inferior to Han Lin's, he was better because of his hard work and his talent. At this time, he also broke through to the first level of Qi training.
A few days ago, when he heard that Han Lin had earned tens of thousands of points overnight, Yue Qingshan's eyes turned red with envy, and he kept thinking about why he was not so lucky.
Now that I heard that Han Lin didn't hide from practicing, but ran to the mine, I felt a lot more balanced.
He secretly thought that this ugly guy had a lot of luck, but his brain was not working well. Now that's good, the points that haven't warmed up yet will soon become Brother Zhao's bag.
When Senior Brother Zhao is happy, he might even reward us with some points.
Thinking of this, Yue Qingshan couldn't help but laugh.
"You're laughing at me! Follow me quickly. The mine is so big, it won't be easy to find." Zhao Ruiling glared at Yue Qingshan.
"Uh, yes, yes!"
Yue Qingshan came to his senses and quickly followed the others into the cave.
other side.
Han Lin had already gone deep into the mine and came to a complicated area in the middle, like a maze, with mined tunnels everywhere.
Han Lin did not open a new channel by himself, but used the Eye of Heaven to pick out leaks in places where others had mined.
But my luck didn't seem to be good today. I walked through several passages in a row, and there was no blue and white jade in the stone walls on both sides.
Just as he was about to come out of a winding passage, he suddenly heard footsteps coming from outside. It seemed like someone was walking in.
Han Lin suddenly became alert and hid around the corner to look outside.
"Yue Qingshan?"
When he looked around, he saw a fat man walking towards the room looking around.
This Yue Qingshan may have eaten too much. Over the past year, his body has enlarged in size, and his face is covered with fat.
It is very difficult to walk in this narrow passage.
"Han Lin, are you in there, Han Lin!" When he came to a particularly narrow place, Yue Qingshan stopped and shouted because he didn't want to squeeze in anymore.
Han Lin had already guessed that Yue Qingshan was probably following Zhao Ruiling's orders to come specifically to look for him, so he pretended not to hear.
Yue Qingshan shouted several times, but when he saw no response at all, he cursed secretly, turned around and left.
When I came outside, I met Zeng Ping and others who were also searching for Han Lin.
Zeng Ping glanced at the passage behind Yue Qingshan and asked, "No?"
Yue Qingshan shook his head: "No, I don't know where that bastard is hiding. I will make him look good when I find him soon!"
As soon as these words came out, Han Lin, who was hiding inside, felt a chill in his heart.
Zeng Ping said: "Forget it, let's continue searching, and don't miss any passage! Senior Brother Zhao said, whoever finds Han Lin first will be rewarded with 100 points!"
"Yes!"
After hearing this, everyone cheered up and walked forward quickly.
Han Lin hid in the passage until Zeng Ping and his party were completely gone, then cautiously came out and continued looking for the blue and white jade.
Zeng Ping and others did not expect that Han Lin would search the area they had searched for more than an hour, but could not find any trace of Han Lin.
Seeing that it was getting late, he returned to the main road and asked Zhao Ruiling to explain the situation.
